---
title: "River Discharge"
output: html_document
---


``` {r River Discharge}
## River Discharge
RiverDischarge_monthly <- RiverDischarge_Data %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(time),
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Year, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    RiverDischarge_mean = if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_ else mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate the historical distribution for each station and month, excluding ReportYear. 
# This gives us the typical monthly HISTORICAL conditions
RiverDischarge_historical <- RiverDischarge_monthly %>%
  filter(Year >= 1977, Year <= ReportYear - 1) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Historical_mean = mean(RiverDischarge_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_sd = sd(RiverDischarge_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_low = quantile(RiverDischarge_mean, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Historical_high = quantile(RiverDischarge_mean, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Isolate ReportYear value
RiverDischarge_current <- RiverDischarge_monthly %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear) %>%
  select(StationCode, Month, RiverDischarge_current = RiverDischarge_mean)

# combine the two tables
RiverDischarge_comparison <- RiverDischarge_historical %>%
  left_join(RiverDischarge_current, by = c("StationCode", "Month")) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = RiverDischarge_current - Historical_mean,
    Anomaly = Difference / Historical_sd
  )

# RiverDischarge Figure
RiverDischargeFigure <- ggplot(RiverDischarge_comparison, aes(x = Month)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = Historical_low,
      ymax = Historical_high
    ),
    alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Historical_mean),
    linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = RiverDischarge_current),
    linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(y = RiverDischarge_current),
    size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ StationCode) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month.abb) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "River Discharge (ft³/s)",
    title = "2025 River Discharge Compared with Historical Conditions",
    subtitle = "Historical period: 1977–2024; shaded area represents the 10th–90th percentile range") +
  
  theme_classic()

RiverDischargeFigure

RiverDischarge_daily_current <- RiverDischarge_Data %>%
  filter(time >= ReportStart)

```
